title: Trump Swings to Diplomacy in Iran: A Tech Perspective
excerpt: President Trump's shift from threatening massive military action to pursuing diplomatic talks with Iran marks a critical juncture in US-Iran relations. This article explores the implications for technology professionals, examining how cybersecurity, military tech, and supply chain risks are intertwined with the evolving geopolitical landscape.
description: President Trump's shift to diplomacy with Iran impacts cybersecurity, military tech, and supply chains. Critical for tech professionals.
